checkpointSchema.typedArrays: Exact little-endian active prefixes as base64; no full decimal number-array copies.
checkpointSchema.height: One exact F32 height per water-grid node; complete cubic callback domain.
checkpointSchema.omitted: Static bed/init arrays, packed dry/foam surface channel. Compact checkpoint is not a complete normal-render replay.

viewportMethod: 1280×720 CSS viewport; native devicePixelRatio and High render ratio are preserved/measured, unlike held DPR1. No device-scale override.
method: Real unpaused C24 original-video-context runtime and actual cached drawBarrel. Fixed first source record meeting the predeclared maturity and indexed-air predicate, no appearance ranking or retargeting; ordinary camera set before the unchanged classifier. Read-only fresh geometry/coverage/fog recorded at the actual default-scene clear after production draw and classifier. No manual sync/upload/provenance or fog edits.
gates: same-front/source-column open→phase2/touchdown→three fresh rows of rendered/source column removal
actual fresh source/drawn/attribute provenance and positive indexed rows
real held cached draws retain attribute/index/mask versions
all physical clocks remain ordinary or explicitly paused for final controls
limitations: Instrumentation and checkpoints add CPU/GPU work; cadence is not ordinaryFPS.
dx1/render1 C24 context differs from ordinary C64/dx2/render2 performance defaults.

Maturity uses F32 controls captured with the actual matching drawn field; current host buffers are never mixed into the baseline preceding field. Baseline classification is pre-draw; combined classification is post-draw. Camera-planning field freshness and actual freshly drawn air are reported separately.
Rendered column removal is distinguished from front/source records disappearing; no assertion about unrelated fronts.

Maturity is an engineering eligibility guard, not a guarantee of future source continuity. Missing eligible source/lifecycle within hard bounds is incomplete. Separate native held proof, independent checkpoint contact oracle and throughput remain required.
